chunks: Al-Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad al-Baṣrī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Sulaymān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥakam, from his father, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:

Indeed, ʿAlī is my legatee and my khalifah, and his wife Fāṭimah, my daughter, is the leader of the women of the worlds. Al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn are the leaders of the youths of the people of Paradise, and they are my two sons. Whoever befriends them has befriended me; whoever opposes them has opposed me; whoever shows hostility to them has shown hostility to me; whoever shuns them has shunned me; and whoever honors them has honored me. Allah maintains ties with whoever maintains ties with them, severs whoever severs from them, supports whoever aids them, and forsakes whoever forsakes them.

O Allah, for whoever among Your Prophets and Messengers had entrusted ones and a household, then ʿAlī, Fāṭimah, al-Ḥasan, and al-Ḥusayn are my Ahl al-Bayt and my entrusted ones; so remove defilement from them and purify them with a thorough purification.

key_terms.ثَقَلِي: my weighty trust or entrusted legacy
key_terms.خَلِيفَتِي: my khalifah or successor in authority
key_terms.سَيِّدَا شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: the two leaders of the youth of Paradise
key_terms.سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ: the leader of the women of the worlds

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the status of ʿAlī, Fāṭimah, al-Ḥasan, and al-Ḥusayn as the Prophet’s Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the special rank of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, Sayyidah Fāṭimah عليها السلام, and al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام as the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم Ahl al-Bayt. It links loyalty to them with loyalty to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and includes a supplication for their purification from all impurity.
